origin.local_frame: x = E - E0, y = h, z = -(N - N0) (docs/data-contract.md)

palace_grid.note: u = along the Ehrenhof axis (towards E avenue KB-12), v = towards N (az 350.5). E = E0+u*0.98629-v*0.16505; N = N0+u*0.16505+v*0.98629

conventions.footprint: closed ring [[E,N],...], CCW, EPSG:25832; null = documented but unplaced
conventions.base_h: floor/terrace level the storey stack starts from (m DHHN2016); ground_dtm gives today's terrain under the footprint (min/median/max) so the generator can extend plinths
conventions.storeys: bottom-up incl. plinth; eaves_h = base_h + sum(storeys); ridge_h computed from roof type + depth
conventions.confidence: high = position+form evidenced; med = position evidenced, form from comparables/HMS; low = hypothesis
conventions.placement: lidar | lidar+hms | map+lidar | existing | relative | hypothetical | unplaced
conventions.tags: D documented, D-> derived, I inferred, N period norm, U unknown; HMS = secondary (copyrighted reconstruction, interpretation only)
conventions.classes: CDL, WING2, RANGE1, PAV, STABLE, RIDE, ORANG, FARM, GARD, WALL - templates in research/02 section 2

open_questions: Which way did the Ehrenhof open? Synthesis: W (HMS + no W closing wall in LiDAR); verify with Le Clerc 1790 / 1805 ruin map / 2006 Lageplan.
Mansard only on the Corps de logis (en.wikipedia) or on all Ehrenhof wings (HMS 2022)? Generator must support both.
Exact CdL footprint: east range at u 28-46 (this draft) or inside the terrace? Needs the 1804/1825 plans or Schwan 2010 p. XXXI.
Axis counts and storey heights of every wing (Schwan 2010, Weber 1987 'Ausmasse des Hauptgebaeudes').
Position of Kavaliersbau, Remisen, Marstall/Reithalle, Hundezwinger, Kasernen, Lazarett, Brauerei (only HMS-level or none).
Is KB-34 the 1785 Rotunde (D 28/34 m) or a basin/modern feature? Weber has its plan, section and elevations.
Cascade: 10 x 1.5 m (15 m) vs 26-39 m LiDAR fall.
Roof covering (slate vs Biberschwanz) and render/member colours outside the Orangerie.
Baumagazin 1793 length and roof (today shortened, roof changed, one end raised).
Karlslust lies S of N 5465000, outside the explorer 'karlsberg' AOI (381000-384000 / 5465000-5468000): AOI must be extended south to ~5464550.
